name: How does Frasheski Construction ensure quality in deck board replacement projects?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction ensure quality in deck board replacement projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction ensures quality in deck board replacement projects by adhering to rigorous installation standards and using suitable materials. Our process includes a thorough inspection of the deck's substructure to identify any hidden issues before new boards are installed. We carefully select durable, weather-appropriate materials that are properly fastened to maximize longevity and safety. Furthermore, our project managers oversee the work to ensure precision and adherence to agreed-upon specifications, ensuring the final result meets both structural requirements and aesthetic expectations for homeowners in Berkeley and the wider East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction ensures quality by thoroughly inspecting the substructure, using durable materials, and overseeing installation to meet structural and aesthetic standards.
